title: Oklahoma City Thunder: Prairie Thunder Basketball
imageHint: The electric blue and orange of Paycom Center with passionate fans creating one of the NBA's loudest atmospheres
description: From the Seattle SuperSonics relocation to building a young, exciting team around Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, the Thunder have become synonymous with passionate fanbase support and smart team building.

questions.question: What year did the Seattle SuperSonics relocate to Oklahoma City to become the Thunder?
questions.explanation: The Seattle SuperSonics moved to Oklahoma City in 2008, becoming the Thunder and bringing NBA basketball to Oklahoma for the first time.

questions.question: Who is the current superstar player and face of the Thunder franchise, known for his exceptional length and scoring ability?
questions.explanation: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has emerged as one of the NBA's brightest young stars, leading the Thunder's rebuild with his elite scoring and playmaking.

questions.question: What is the name of the Thunder's home arena in downtown Oklahoma City?
questions.explanation: The Thunder play at Paycom Center (formerly Chesapeake Energy Arena), known for having one of the loudest and most passionate fanbases in the NBA.

questions.question: Which former Thunder player known as "The Brodie" was famous for averaging a triple-double multiple seasons?
questions.explanation: Russell Westbrook, nicknamed "The Brodie," became the first player since Oscar Robertson to average a triple-double for a season, doing it three times with the Thunder.

questions.question: What unique draft strategy has Thunder GM Sam Presti employed, accumulating an unprecedented number of what type of assets?
questions.explanation: Sam Presti has masterfully accumulated over 30 first-round draft picks through trades, giving the Thunder unprecedented flexibility for team building and player development.
